primitives.definition: The subject is a location in the filesystem namespace and the object is directly inside it.
primitives.identity_condition: Two containment assertions are the same instance when they name the same parent entry and the same child entry.
primitives.name: contains

primitives.definition: The subject is a container file and the object is a stream, member, or region recoverable from inside it by opening it.
primitives.identity_condition: Two embedding assertions are the same instance when they name the same container entry and the same member locator.
primitives.name: embeds

primitives.definition: The object was produced from the subject by some process, such that the subject's content materially determined the object's.
primitives.identity_condition: Two derivation assertions are the same instance when they name the same producer, the same product, and the same activity where one is reified.
primitives.name: derives

primitives.definition: The two entities have the same content, established by cryptographic comparison of the whole content.
primitives.identity_condition: Two identity assertions are the same instance when they name the same unordered pair of entries under the same hash algorithm.
primitives.name: identical

primitives.definition: The two entities are the same with respect to a stated dimension R, and differ or are unknown in every other respect.
primitives.identity_condition: Two equivalence assertions are the same instance when they name the same unordered pair of entries under the same respect.
primitives.name: equivalent

primitives.definition: The subject comes after the object in an ordered series to which both belong. Order only; it claims no material dependence.
primitives.identity_condition: Two succession assertions are the same instance when they name the same ordered pair within the same series.
primitives.name: succeeds

primitives.definition: The subject mentions, names, or points at the object, without necessarily depending on it.
primitives.identity_condition: Two reference assertions are the same instance when they name the same source entry, the same reference string, and the same resolution outcome.
primitives.name: references

primitives.definition: The two entities are about the same subject matter.
primitives.identity_condition: Two aboutness assertions are the same instance when they name the same unordered pair under the same theme kind.
primitives.name: concerns

specializations.definition: The object was produced by the named activity.

specializations.definition: The subject was consumed by the named activity.
specializations.name: used_as_input

specializations.definition: Produced by a processing step over the subject.
specializations.name: processed_from

specializations.definition: A visual rendering of the subject.
specializations.name: rendered_from

specializations.definition: A reduction or aggregate of the subject.
specializations.name: summarized_from

specializations.definition: The same content in a different format.
specializations.name: converted_from

specializations.definition: The subject with a correction applied.
specializations.name: corrected_from

specializations.definition: Same experimental design, performed on a separate occasion.
specializations.name: replicate_of

specializations.definition: Same design with one dimension deliberately changed.
specializations.name: variant_of

specializations.definition: Same normalized column names and types.
specializations.name: same_schema_as

specializations.definition: Same array shape and dtype signature.
specializations.name: same_shape_as

specializations.definition: Same experimental condition, without implying a separate occasion.
specializations.name: same_condition_as

specializations.definition: Produced by one acquisition event.
specializations.name: same_acquisition_as

specializations.definition: The same input analyzed again, by the same or a different method.
specializations.name: reanalysis_of

specializations.definition: A later version in a version series.
specializations.name: version_of

specializations.definition: A revision of the subject.
specializations.name: revision_of

specializations.definition: The same procedure run again.
specializations.name: rerun_of

specializations.definition: A later session in a session series.
specializations.name: session_after

specializations.definition: The subject describes the object.
specializations.name: documents

specializations.definition: The subject cites the object.
specializations.name: cites

specializations.definition: The subject supplies configuration to the object.
specializations.name: configures

specializations.definition: The subject states that it writes the object. The object may not exist.
specializations.name: declares_output

specializations.definition: The subject states that it reads the object. The object may not exist.
specializations.name: declares_input

specializations.definition: Shares a technique.

specializations.definition: Shares an instrument.

specializations.definition: Shares a subject of study.
specializations.name: about_subject

specializations.definition: Belongs to the same project.
specializations.name: about_project

specializations.definition: A directory holding the object.
specializations.name: directory_of

specializations.definition: A member of an archive.
specializations.name: archive_member

specializations.definition: A sheet within a workbook.
specializations.name: sheet_of

specializations.definition: An attachment within a document.
specializations.name: attachment_of

specializations.definition: A stream within a container file.
specializations.name: stream_of
